description: E1 (decision E1-2): the Skarn's answer to a colossus - a giant's harpoon engine (scripts/world/fetter_winch.gd): a timber sled staked into the ground with iron pins, a great bow and its stock, a drum of chain behind it, 7.5 m to the bow's tips. Crewed by Skarn giants (10 m), it turns at 22 degrees a second and draws its barbed harpoon at a giant 24-220 m off; where the harpoon bites, its chain holds him (one chain a winch: it holds its fire while its chain is on him). Torn free, the chain wrenches the winch out of the ground. A colossus breaks it with a blow or two - or, from stage 8, by striding through it (trample_stage 8).
